instruction: Please move the text layer to the top-left corner of the canvas. I want it positioned in the upper-left area.

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the text layer to the top-left corner. The evaluator checks if both the leftmost and topmost dark pixels are within 5% from their respective edges.
